review.notes: Triage review: all 56 physical pages machine-scanned (48 balanced code fences, none swallowing document structure; normalized 4-gram page-text containment, mean 0.95; spaced-digit and escape pattern scan). Low-containment pages 48, 50, 51 inspected line-by-line: the divergences are the ICLR running header (consistently absent, not body content) and the printed configuration-key table on p.48. Two defect classes confirmed on p.48 and p.24: OCR auto-corrected the print's own identifier misspelling 'contigious' to 'contiguous' in three config-table cells, and equation (3) RoPE base 10000 was transcribed with spaced digits. Both verified on 300-500 dpi renders. Remaining \_ escapes render as the printed underscores (v_proj, word_embedding, pile_cc); no other droppage found.

Rendered physical p.48 prints 'zero_contigious_gradients' twice (True/False value variants of the configuration table, 500 dpi crop + exact text layer); OCR auto-corrected both cells to 'contiguous'. Restored the printed spelling.
